articles.title: Petrol, Diesel Prices Rose Just 7% in India Over Four Years Against 50-70% Global Surge: Hardeep Puri
articles.description: Union Minister Hardeep Puri said petrol and diesel prices in India rose just 7% over four years, compared with a 50-70% global surge. He credited three excise duty cuts and oil companies for absorbing losses, while asserting that India had no LPG shortage.

articles.title: Petrol, diesel prices rose 7% in India vs 50-70% globally over four years: Hardeep Puri
articles.description: Union Minister Hardeep Singh Puri announced that fuel prices in India have risen by just 7% over four years. The government implemented three reductions in central excise duty, helping maintain stable prices. Puri criticized rumors of an LPG shortage, emphasizing increased domestic production of LPG. Challenges from international conflicts and geopolitical tensions still persist, affecting the crude oil market.
